contributions.statement: Keep LLM method-level vulnerability classification on Java advisory and keep deterministic SAST as the merge gate, since detectors scored F1 of roughly 0.3-0.5 on project-disjoint data.
contributions.evidence: Tables 1-3: encoder models drop on project-disjoint split; API LLMs evaluated on a 200-sample probe, single seed, no CIs; no SAST baseline, so 'SAST is better' is not shown.
relative_to: random splits inflate vulnerability-detector scores (PrimeVul-style findings for C/C++)

reason: Useful Java dataset artifact for evaluating a security-review step, but its findings restate the known split-leakage result with weaker numbers and no SAST comparison; no new actionable practice.
